title: Probing the Spacetime Structure of Entanglement in Monitored Quantum Circuits with Graph Neural Networks
summary: Global entanglement in quantum many-body systems is inherently nonlocal, raising the question of whether it can be inferred from local observations. We investigate this problem in monitored quantum circuits, where projective measurements generate classical records distributed across spacetime. Using graph neural networks (GNNs), we represent individual quantum trajectories as directed spacetime graphs and reconstruct the half-chain entanglement entropy from local measurement data alone.
